notes: The default base judge backbone is M-Prometheus-3B via Unbabel/M-Prometheus-3B.
Prometheus-family backends require torch, transformers, and accelerate.
Current PyTorch build has CUDA 12.8 support and detects the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU.
The 8 GB GPU may require device_map=auto CPU offload for M-Prometheus-3B when desktop applications are also using VRAM.
If Hugging Face TLS or network access is unavailable, set model_path to a local directory containing config.json and model weights.
The current lightweight training pipeline avoids network-dependent packages.
scikit-learn and scipy are not required for this lightweight implementation.
